title: Rhythm and Revenge
description: After losing her parents, Journi, a talented but troubled teenager, moves in with her aunt and cousin for a fresh start. As she navigates the pressures of competitive dance, strange accidents begin to occur around her.

title: The Drive
description: A doctor is driving home from a conference when he learns his daughter has been kidnapped and the betrayal comes from those closest to him. The certainty that someone within his trusted circle is responsible turns the journey into a spiral of shock.

title: How Did We Get Here
description: Four struggling couples attend a wellness retreat led by Dr. Sellers. Melonie and Derrick struggle with issues of infidelity.

title: Desperate Desires
description: Marathon runner Mia is pursued by Jay, while Tori and Paul desire a baby. A one-night stand leaves Mia pregnant, creates an opportunity for Tori and Paul. When Mia disappears, a darker plot ensues. Whose desires will prevail?

title: The Perfect Mother
description: Linda, a determined mother, faces the daily struggles of raising her son amidst the unpredictable presence of her husband. When a series of hardships push her to the edge, Linda's plea for assistance leads to Ahmad being taken into CPS custody.

title: Reality TV Murders
description: Chasity Safire is a household name and has been the star of the hugely popular reality TV show "Diva's Doing it'." When one of the castmates is found dead, the women become suspects and we discover that some of them would literally kill to be famous.

title: A Matter of Heart
description: Balen, a successful family man, risks everything for a reckless affair with Latricia that devastates his family. His devoted wife, Krista, will soon face a painful truth that shows her sacrifices may have been in vain.

title: Game of Cards
description: When data analyst Nicole Tucker's car is broken into and a mysterious military-issued card tied to her family legacy is stolen, she's thrust into a dangerous game of betrayal.

title: The New Girl
description: When her sister Monica suddenly disappears under suspicious circumstances, Malorie becomes convinced that Monica's seemingly perfect husband is hiding something sinister.

title: Trouble
description: As Draven faces financial ruin and a serious illness, her marriage to Adam frays. She reconnects with Cecilius, a wealthy ex, finding comfort in his stability. But as their romance blossoms, Adam's jealousy spirals into a dangerous.

title: Mr. Hit Me Up
description: Lifelong best friends seemingly beat the trauma of their childhood, but a podcast challenges their bond and exposes one's deepest secrets.

title: Kinfolk
description: Eboni is a hair stylist dreaming of owning a successful salon in her hometown, with the support of her half-siblings Beau and Hillary. Things get complicated when their father attempts to reconcile for the past.

title: Broken Harmony
description: Harmony is on the verge of being dropped from her record label; her manager, suggests she returns to Atlanta to refresh her sound; she must reunite with her mother and is forced to face her childhood trauma.

title: Don't Miss the Bus

title: Buried
description: After the murder of his fiancée and her lover, Cameron escapes Atlanta under a new identity and loses the trail of the investigators.

title: Deceptive Touch
description: Cam believes she's finally found "The One" in her charismatic boyfriend Ant. Everything seems perfect until a shocking discovery about Ant's past threatens to unravel their idyllic life.

title: The Lineup
description: Sebastian "Bas" Monte is an up-and-coming influencer and club promoter. He doesn't have the time to commit to only one woman, so he schedules out different women for his needs. That is until he meets Mikayla, and he questions his playboy ways.

title: The Good Sister
description: Raven moves in with her sister Devin and her husband in Atlanta, where she begins to dig her claws into Devin's life and home, and seducing her husband. Devin must make a choice that could be deadly to save her own life and happiness.

title: Apex
description: A special ops team enters the underground bunker "Hades" to rescue missing scientists, only to uncover a terrifying secret far beyond their expectations.

When the remains of an apartheid-era policeman are discovered 60 years after he went missing, a retired singer revisits her past to help with the investigation. But how much does she know, and what is she holding back?

description: Cassie, a young woman searching for purpose, meets Ryan, who offers her a chance to step into the world of fame and opportunity. With guidance from her best friend, Ledrick, Cassie navigates the glamorous yet cutthroat entertainment industry.

title: But I'm Married
description: Kimora and Jamal's seemingly perfect marriage falters. Seeking to reignite passion, Kimora explores unconventional options, including a third person. This decision unleashes a web of lies and betrayal, forcing Kimora to confront hidden desires.

title: Too Much, Too Soon
description: Based on the autobiography of Diana Barrymore (Dorothy Malone), the troubled daughter of actor John Barrymore (Errol Flynn).
